name: Savings Goals Planner

listing.title: Savings Goals Planner - Printable Target Dates and Deposits Log
listing.description:
A printable savings planner with an Excel spreadsheet to track progress towards financial targets.

Inside the printable PDF: a cover, a How to use page, the Goals Table page with target date, the Deposits Log page, and the Savings Notes page.

Also includes an Excel (.xlsx) file with a Deposits tab.

Print on A4 or US Letter paper for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults who want an organized savings goals system

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% scale.
Set your target amounts and target dates on the Goals Table page.
Log each deposit on the Deposits Log page.
Open the .xlsx file in Excel to maintain a digital record in the Deposits tab.
cover_image_idea: The Goals Table page printed on paper next to a computer screen.
